name: Restaurant Reservation Platform
description: Distributed restaurant reservation platform built on a 4-microservice architecture using Java and Spring Boot. Developed as a collaborative academic project during an Erasmus+ exchange at Universidade Lusófona in Lisbon.
functionalities: Decoupled core business domains into four independent microservices for modularity, scalability, and fault isolation
Synchronous request-response workflows via RESTful APIs
Asynchronous, event-driven inter-service messaging powered by Apache Kafka

name: Lisbon Metro Mobile Application
description: Cross-platform mobile application built in Flutter and Dart to explore Lisbon Metro stations, featuring an interactive map with real-time geolocation and full offline support.
functionalities: Offline-first architecture using the Repository Pattern with automatic fallback from the official Metro Lisboa REST API to a local SQLite database
Interactive map displaying all Lisbon Metro stations alongside real-time device geolocation
Local service incident reporting and persistence across both online and offline sessions
